# Either exit status is acceptable, for registered and explicit commands.
? status 0
? status 7
? exec status 0
? exec status 7

# Both forms of wait use the expectation from the command that was started.
? status 1 &named&
wait named
? exec status 0 &
? exec status 1 &
wait

# A command's output can still be asserted.
? fprintargs stdout matched
stdout '^matched$'

# Custom commands that accept a mode see all three prefixes.
showmode
stdout 'mode ""'
! showmode
stdout 'mode "!"'
? showmode
stdout 'mode "\?"'
? localmode
stdout 'local "\?"'

# Syntax, unsupported commands, and failure to start are still errors.
! testscript -files missing.txt
stdout 'unexpected command failure'
! testscript -files unsupported.txt
stdout 'command does not support the \? prefix'
! testscript -files prefix.txt
stdout '\? on line by itself'

-- missing.txt --
? exec definitely-missing-testscript-executable
-- unsupported.txt --
? some-param-cmd
-- prefix.txt --
?
